contract: POST /logout candidate recorded from server/Auth.js:486. Method, path, query/body variants, auth/permission gates, payload shape/types, errors and side effects must match upstream v2.37.2.
exceptions: This record covers one successful web OIDC logout state transition; repeat, error and edge variants remain unverified.

invariants.contract: In the selected web OIDC session case, POST /logout matches Express response JSON and ETag, clears the three auth cookies with upstream attributes, and deletes the active refresh session while retaining the user. Passport regenerates connect.sid during logout; the existing OIDC differential normalizes its value, so OIDC-specific replacement remains unverified.
exceptions: Only a successful web OIDC session with no provider logout endpoint is covered; logout errors, allDevices and mobile logout remain unverified.

invariants.contract: Local logout without OIDC: clears refresh_token and auth_method cookies with epoch Expires, REGENERATES the session — every logout responds with a fresh signed connect.sid (Path=/, HttpOnly) replacing the previously presented identifier — responds 200 json {'redirect_url':null} with exact Express JSON headers (21-byte body), deletes the session row for the presented current refresh token (a rotated/stale token leaves a live session), and the access token remains usable afterwards.
exceptions: Local login/logout connect.sid regeneration is verified by F05 within-side value assertions. OIDC-specific callback/start/logout cookie lifecycle remains unverified because the OIDC differential normalizes connect.sid values.
Logout with no refresh token presented, allDevices=1, logout errors and mobile logout remain separate unverified variants.
